subject: English
title: CBSE English, Class IV

source.read: Directorate of Education, Delhi: Class IV English annual syllabus 2026-27, built on the NCERT textbook Santoor (NCF-SE 2023) that CBSE schools use
source.note: UNOFFICIAL SOURCE. CBSE does not publish a line-by-line English syllabus below Class 9; this list follows a state education department's year plan for the NCERT book Santoor, read through a text summary of the PDF. Chapters are named by kind, not reproduced.

outcomes.text: Uses collective nouns, countable and uncountable nouns, and articles.
Uses prepositions such as behind, between, near and in front of.
Uses adjectives and their forms, and adverbs.
Uses the simple past and the past continuous.
Asks questions and joins ideas with conjunctions.
Uses words that sound alike, opposites and words of the same meaning.
